title: Tips for Healthy Chinese Cooking
synopsis: Learn about healthy cooking, Chinese style.

fullText.simplified:
中国健康烹饪小贴士

    世界各地的美食多了去了，但是要说既美味又养生的话，我看可能就只有中餐了。
    中国人自古就信赖中医。而中医除了治病外，还讲究食疗养生。老百姓的生活中处处都有养生的影子。
    做饭的时候，哪些食物放在一起最有营养，哪些食物绝对不能放在一起，这都是有讲究的。比如：西红柿和黄瓜不可以放在一起炒，因为营养彼此相克，就没有了；大虾和西红柿最好别一起吃，因为这两种食材混在一起会产生毒素。
    羊肉常常跟白萝卜一起熬汤，对身体虚弱的人来说绝对是大补。但是爱上火的人千万别吃，否则容易流鼻血。
    鸡肉和蘑菇（一定要是东北的野生山蘑菇）一起炖，炖出来以后，蘑菇和鸡肉融合在一起的味道让人欲罢不能呀！这道菜可以帮人减压，提高抵抗力。
    你瞧，中国菜里到处是学问。中国人做菜的理念就是吃出美味，吃出健康。再加上中医文化的影响，养生文化渗透进了人们生活的方方面面。学汉语的同时，再学几道中国菜，做给家人尝尝，也不错哦！
fullText.traditional:
中國健康烹飪小貼士

    世界各地的美食多了去了，但是要說既美味又養生的話，我看可能就只有中餐了。
    中國人自古就信賴中醫。而中醫除了治病外，還講究食療養生。老百姓的生活中處處都有養生的影子。
    做飯的時候，哪些食物放在一起最有營養，哪些食物絕對不能放在一起，這都是有講究的。比如：西紅柿和黃瓜不可以放在一起炒，因為營養彼此相剋，就沒有了；大蝦和西紅柿最好別一起吃，因為這兩種食材混在一起會產生毒素。
    羊肉常常跟白蘿蔔一起熬湯，對身體虛弱的人來說絕對是大補。但是愛上火的人千萬別吃，否則容易流鼻血。
    雞肉和蘑菇（一定要是東北的野生山蘑菇）一起燉，燉出來以後，蘑菇和雞肉融合在一起的味道讓人欲罷不能呀！這道菜可以幫人減壓，提高抵抗力。
    你瞧，中國菜裡到處是學問。中國人做菜的理念就是吃出美味，吃出健康。再加上中醫文化的影響，養生文化滲透進了人們生活的方方面面。學漢語的同時，再學幾道中國菜，做給家人嘗嘗，也不錯哦！

sentences.simplified: 老百姓的生活中处处都有养生的影子。
sentences.traditional: 老百姓的生活中處處都有養生的影子。

sentences.english: In addition to treating diseases, traditional Chinese medicine also emphasizes food therapy for healthy living.
This attention to health is reflected in every aspect of ordinary people’s lives.

sentences.traditional: 大蝦和西紅柿最好別一起吃，因為這兩種食材混在一起會產生毒素。

sentences.traditional: 但是愛上火的人千萬別吃，否則容易流鼻血。

But people who tend to suffer from excessive internal eat must not eat it. Otherwise, they will easily get nosebleeds.

sentences.traditional: 燉出來以後，蘑菇和雞肉融合在一起的味道讓人欲罷不能呀！

sentences.english: After stewing, the taste of the mushrooms and chicken mixed together is irresistible!
This dish can help people reduce stress and strengthen their immune systems.

sentences.traditional: 你瞧，中國菜裡到處是學問。

sentence_translations: Tips for Healthy Chinese Cooking
Around the world there is plenty of delicious food, ..
.. but if we’re talking about food that is both delicious and healthy, ..
.. I think there is none other than Chinese food.
Since ancient times, Chinese people have relied on traditional Chinese medicine.
In addition to treating diseases, traditional Chinese medicine also emphasizes food therapy for healthy living.
This attention to health is reflected in every aspect of ordinary people’s lives.
When cooking, which foods are most nutritious when put together, which foods should never be put together,  ..
.. this requires careful attention.
For example, tomatoes and cucumbers cannot be cooked together because their nutrients counteract each other.
Shrimp and tomatoes are best not eaten together, because when mixed together these two foods will produce toxins.
Mutton is often cooked together with white radish to make a broth.
This is definitely nourishing for people who are weak or in poor health.
But people who tend to suffer from excessive internal eat must not eat it. Otherwise, they will easily get nosebleeds.
Stew chicken and mushrooms (which must be wild mushrooms from the mountains in Northeast China) together.
After stewing, the taste of the mushrooms and chicken mixed together is irresistible!
This dish can help people reduce stress and strengthen their immune systems.
As you can see, Chinese cuisine is full of wisdom.
For Chinese people, the philosophy behind cooking is to eat delicious flavors, and to eat healthy foods.
And combined with the influence of traditional Chinese medicine, ..
.. the health-conscious culture has permeated into every aspect of people’s lives.
When learning Chinese, it would also be good to learn a few Chinese dishes and cook them for your family to try!
